findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_best_endpoint, search_web, run_ai_inference, fetch_page, check_domain, get_trust_data, get_seller_data, create_feed, get_feeds, get_feed_mailbox · Private data: run_ai_inference, create_feed · Public sink: check_domain · Destructive: run_ai_inference, check_domain, delete_feed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_best_endpoint, search_web, run_ai_inference, fetch_page, check_domain, get_trust_data, get_seller_data, create_feed, get_feeds, get_feed_mailbox · Private data: run_ai_inference, create_feed · Public sink: check_domain · Destructive: run_ai_inference, check_domain, delete_feed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool removed since last scan
detail: Tool "request_data" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_btc_data" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Returns JSON `data` with att" → after: "Use this when an agent needs Bitcoin data (BTC/USD, fees, mining, sentiment). kind="intuitive" (default; also get_bitcoin_price): multi-source price + Data BitScore; kind="stats": fees, mempool, mining; kind="pro": stats plus hashprice/fee-share trends; kind="signals": Fear & Greed, RSI 7/14/21, SMA"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
